description: Create a document titled `title`, optionally inside the folder `parent_id`. Returns its doc_id and the standing `instructions` that apply where it was placed — follow them when writing there. Fill it with `markdown_edit` or `markdown_append`, in the same change. For a structured database use `databases_add` action:create_database. ONE piece of work is ONE change, reviewed on one card: an ingest of a meeting or an email, or one Save to Stuga of several points. Give `change_title` (a few words naming its source, never a page's title) to your FIRST write for it, and pass the `change_id` the answer returns to EVERY later write for it, on every page and database; `change_summary` says what it does. A new page made inside a change, where AI edits wait for a colleague, stays visible only to the user and those who may approve it until it is approved. When your earlier change to a page is still undecided, a write there for another change waits behind it in a queue (`queued_behind`): that is SUCCESS, never retry it. Where AI edits wait for a colleague and you name no change, the page opens an untitled one of its own: the answer's `change_id`.

change_id.description: The `change_id` your first write for this piece of work returned: pass it to every later write for it.

change_summary.description: What the change does, in a sentence or two, for whoever approves it; a later write may replace it.

change_title.description: Opens a change for this piece of work and returns its `change_id`: a few words naming its source, as "Customer sync, 2026-10-21".

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a `workspace_id` from `workspaces` action:list, which also says which node it is on.

name: docs_create
title: Create a document
